data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'philos' meaning 'friend'. In the New Testament, Philip is one of the twelve apostles, and is known for his hospitality and evangelism. The name Phil carries the meaning “Friend of” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Phil usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of love, friendship, and unity.
data.etymology: Phil belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend of.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Phil total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
data.cultural_impact: The name Philip was popular among early Christians and is used extensively in Western cultures. The name evokes images of camaraderie, friendship, and loyalty, reflecting the biblical character's traits.
data.spiritual_significance: Philip's name symbolizes a deep and profound commitment to one's faith and to building spiritual connections with others. It's a reminder to live a life rooted in love and hospitality, following in the footsteps of the apostle and extending the spirit of fellowship to all we encounter.
